record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace each Transformer feed-forward sublayer with GEGLU: project the normalized state into two 2H-wide branches, multiply one branch by GELU of the other, then project back to H. Jointly learned gating may capture selective item-context interactions beyond the existing GELU feed-forward layer. Retain bidirectional attention, two blocks, residual placement, normalization, embeddings, sequence/readout, loss and optimizer. Train one model per category and load the same architecture in prediction.

+class GEGLUTransformerEncoderLayer(nn.TransformerEncoderLayer):
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(
+            self.linear1.in_features,
+            self.linear1.out_features * 2,
+            bias=self.linear1.bias is not None,
+        )
+        # Disable the fused GELU/ReLU path so evaluation uses the gated sublayer.
+        self.activation_relu_or_gelu = 0
+
+    def _ff_block(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        value, gate = self.linear1(x).chunk(2, dim=-1)
+        gated = value * torch.nn.functional.gelu(gate)
+        return self.dropout2(self.linear2(self.dropout(gated)))
+
